user_intent: 如果 人在家 那么 增加 亮度
期望 温度 处于 22 ℃ 到 25 ℃
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN brightness_up() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF aqara_temperature_sensor.reading() > 25 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_cool_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF aqara_temperature_sensor.reading() < 22 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_heat_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(Temperature) < 25 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() != false THEN turn_heat_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(Temperature) > 25 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() != false THEN turn_cool_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(pm2.5Density) > 88 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_air_fresh
IF yunmi_water_purifier.tds_in() < 79 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() yunmi_water_purifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN light_off() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() zhimi_air_fresh
